convert_json_schema_to_grammar: convert a JSON schema file to an EBNF grammar file using the json_schema_to_grammar CLI tool
fetch_remote_schema_and_convert: fetch a remote JSON schema over HTTPS and convert it to a grammar with --allow-fetch
convert_schema_with_property_order: convert a JSON schema to grammar with custom property ordering using --prop-order
convert_pattern_with_dotall: convert a JSON schema with regex patterns treating dot as matching all chars using --dotall
convert_raw_pattern_schema: convert a JSON schema with raw string patterns without quote escapes using --raw-pattern
